name: demangle_symbol
title: Demangle Symbol
description: Demangles a C++/Rust/D symbol using LLVM's demangler. Supports Itanium ABI (Linux/macOS), MSVC (Windows), Rust v0, and D. The result's `recognized` field tells you whether the symbol was successfully demangled; an unrecognized symbol is returned unchanged with `recognized=false` so the agent can still see the original input. Pure read.

demangled.description: Demangled form (or original input if unrecognized)

recognized.description: True if demangling produced a different output
